verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a customer-support SaaS that ingests Slack, email and chat data, so the axis applies. The pack never mentions retention policies, deletion workflows, data purge, or retention settings for AI or agent data. The SOC 2 / ISO 27001 certifications and the generic API that can 'take action on data' do not show that users can control retention or deletion.
